conventions.convention: Use η = diag(-1,1,1,1), x⁰ = ct, and the future timelike component v⁰ > |v⃗|. Coordinates have length units, momentum components have SI momentum units, and J has action units.
G = R⁴ ⋊ SO⁺(1,3), with (a,Λ)(b,L) = (a + Λb,ΛL), acts by x′ = Λx + a and p′ = Λ⁻ᵀp. The library fundamental field uses exp(-sξ), and the moment equation is dμξ = -ιξMω.
Pᵃ = ηᵃᵇp_b, Jᵃᵇ = xᵃPᵇ - xᵇPᵃ, and the dual pairing is ℓ(a,A) = p_baᵇ - J_bcAᵇᶜ/2.

On the stated regular common zero surface, first-class means every pairwise constraint bracket vanishes at every point of that surface. It implies neither algorithm termination nor a regular global quotient.
ε₀₁₂₃ = +1 and ε⁰¹²³ = -1; Wᵃ = εᵃᵇᶜᵈP_bJ_cd/2. The positive-spin orbit uses m > 0 and s > 0; s = 0 is treated separately.

Hamilton–Jacobi existence uses smooth H and S₀, an initial exact-graph point inside the open Hamiltonian domain, and a restricted domain where (t,a) ↦ (t,q(t,a)) is a smooth diffeomorphism. No continuation through projection singularities is supplied.
A complete-integral family is C³ and has invertible S_qα locally. Its new position coordinates are β = S_α, its new momentum coordinates are α, and the target form is Σ dβⁱ ∧ dα_i.
Temporal chart coefficients are evaluated at (ct,q); physical time lies in {t : ct ∈ I₀}. The massless Hamiltonian domain excludes zero spatial momentum.
The spinning model separately adopts the positive-spin KKS orbit and H = cP⁰. This is an optional classical model assumption, with no empirical or quantum-spin conclusion.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the proper orthochronous Poincaré semidirect product, its affine cotangent action, the exp(-sξ) fundamental-field convention, and the equivalent charge pairings ℓ(a,A) = p_b(aᵇ + Aᵇ_cxᶜ) = p_baᵇ - J_bcAᵇᶜ/2.

Under ACω and the defined group and cotangent conventions, μ defined by ⟨μ,ξ⟩ = ℓξ is a smooth equivariant moment map with {ℓξ,ℓη} = ℓ[ξ,η] and the displayed P,J generator brackets. The charges descend on future massive and nonzero future-null shells; the dual action is (P,J) ↦ (ΛP,ΛJΛᵀ + a ∧ ΛP), and B_i = ctp_i - qⁱE/c satisfies ∂tB_i + {B_i,E} = 0.

For smooth H on an open time-cotangent domain and smooth S₀, near each initial point (0,a₀,dS₀(a₀)) in that domain, smooth Hamilton characteristics have an invertible restricted projection. Their endpoint-action integral defines a smooth S with initial value S₀ satisfying S_t + H(t,q,S_q) = 0 on that image.

Under the stated open-domain, smooth-H, C³-family and Hamilton–Jacobi hypotheses, invertible S_qα gives a local C² canonical diffeomorphism (q,p) ↦ (β,α), with p = S_q, β = S_α, target form Σdβⁱ ∧ dα_i, and β constant along Hamilton characteristics. The future covariant shell equation reduces to time Hamilton–Jacobi in the stated temporal chart, excluding the zero null covector.

For m,s,c > 0, the coadjoint orbit through P = (mc,0,0,0), J¹² = s and other independent J components zero is an eight-dimensional KKS symplectic manifold. It is exactly the future joint invariant set P² = -m²c², W·P = 0, W² = m²c²s². At s = 0 the rest stabilizer has dimension four and the orbit dimension is six.

For C_m = (gᵃᵇp_ap_b + m²c²)/2 and Fξ = p_aξᵃ, the canonical bracket is {Fξ,C_m} = -(Lξg⁻¹)ᵃᵇp_ap_b/2. For Killing ξ it vanishes for every covector, and Fξ is constant along constrained free-shell trajectories on their actual intervals.
A regular constraint family is first-class on its common zero surface N exactly when {χ_a,χ_b}(z) = 0 for every z ∈ N and all a,b.

concerns.concern: Facts [F1] attributes both “J^{01}=x^0P^1-x^1P^0” and “P^0=E/c on the positive-energy inertial shell” to def-rpm-h-poincare-charge-space. That definition supplies J and P but introduces neither E nor the shell relation. The latter is supplied by thm-rpm-h-poincare-moment-map-and-algebra, already cited as [L1]. The calculation is sound; the attribution should distinguish these suppliers.

seams_checked.note: Compared the cited cotangent, regular-constraint, canonical-flow, consistency, flat-shell quotient, inertial Hamiltonian, first-order action, temporal-chart and temporal-reduction interfaces with their actual suppliers. Consumers preserve the bracket sign, future branch, nonzero-null restriction, explicit flat global quotient versus curved local chart distinction, and separate massive/massless model adoption. The Hamilton–Jacobi trajectory proof explicitly reconstructs the full shell lift with e = c/C_p0 and checks the p₀ equation. Supplier draft status is stated rather than promoted to independent approval.
